about: Course thumbnail mapping. Keys are course IDs from the Website Courses sheet (COURSE-### from S.No.). 'source' is the original file in public/Thumbnail Samples; the website serves a resized copy from public/course-thumbnails/<id>.jpg, made by scripts/build-course-thumbnails.py. Only High and Medium confidence matches are listed; see docs/course-thumbnails.md for unmapped courses, unused images and open decisions.
